verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pomelo issues virtual cards and can block specific merchants, categories or merchant IDs. Nothing documents single-use cards, locking a card to one merchant, or exact-amount limits. Merchant blocking is a related deny-list control, and the external-authorizer and 3DS threshold rules are building blocks or adjacent features, so none of them count as delivering this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue single-use and tightly scoped cards — one purchase, one merchant, an exact amount — so a leaked number is worthless the moment it's used
